units.source_text: “我到现在才知道：世间的女人，尽善尽美、没有缺点可指摘的，实在不易多得啊！

en.t: Only now have I come to understand: among women in this world, those who are perfect in every way and have no faults one could point out are truly hard to find!

units.source_text: 仅乎表面上风雅，信也写得漂亮，交际应酬也能干——这样的人不计其数。

en.t: There are countless women who seem refined on the surface, write beautiful letters, and are skilled at social courtesies.

units.source_text: 然而如果真个要在这些方面选拔优秀人物，不落选的实在很少。

en.t: But if one were truly to choose the outstanding ones in these respects, very few would avoid being rejected.

units.source_text: 自己懂得一点的，就拿来一味夸耀而看轻别人，这样令人厌恶的女子，也多得很。

en.t: There are also many disagreeable women who take the little they know, boast of it endlessly, and look down on others.
